en: ...Hah, hah.

jp: お腹が痛くて、無理だよ
en: ...I-I can't... My side hurts too much.
...M-me too.
We have run far enough. We should be safe now.
...J-Johannes-san, you've got more stamina than you look.

jp: 私には翼があるからな
走るより飛ぶ方がずっと速い
en: I have wings. Flying is far faster than running.
...Th-that's cheating, Johannes.

jp: 翼を背負って走るのは
かえって都合が悪いだろう？
en: Running with wings on your back only catches the wind. It would have slowed you, no?
Ugh...

jp: もっと早くに言ってくれれば
ボクだって翼を使ったのに
en: If you'd said so sooner, I would have used my wings too.

jp: 言う暇もなかっただろう？
en: There was hardly time to say so, was there?
...Huh? Where are the two black-wings?

jp: 偶然居合わせただけの
en: We only happened to be in the same place. Nothing more.
They will have made their own escape.

jp: 今日は本当に死ぬかと思ったよ
en: ...Still, I really thought I was gonna die today.
Me too.

jp: 街に来たばかりだというのに
この調子では後が怖いな
en: We have only just arrived in town. At this rate, I dread what comes next.

jp: 誤魔化しきれないだろうな～
en: ...Sigh. After a ruckus like that, there's no hiding it from Cypherpunk~

jp: 今日は帰ったらゲンコツ・・
下手すりゃ晩飯も抜きだぜ
en: Ugh... I'm getting a knuckle to the head when I get back.. maybe no dinner either.

jp: ボクたちが巻き込んだから
en: ...I'm sorry. We dragged you into this.

jp: 勝手に首突っ込んだのは
en: It's fine. I'm the one who stuck my nose in on my own.

jp: ところで、こんなところで
油を売っていていいのか？
en: By the way, should you be loitering around here like this?

jp: ＜サイファーパンク＞の一員なら
何かしら任務があるだろう
en: As a member of Cypherpunk, surely you have some duty or other.

jp: 自分の仕事は大丈夫なのかね？
en: Is your own work in order?
Oh crap! I totally forgot!!

jp: あ～さらば俺の晩飯・・・
en: Ah~ farewell, my dinner...
...Johannes, what do we do now?

jp: 教会への聞き込みも失敗で
結局、マティアの手がかりも
つかめなかったし・・・
en: Asking around at the church failed, and we still have no lead on Matia...
...Indeed.
Hey, you two. Why don't you join Cypherpunk?
Huh?

jp: さすがに相手が悪かったけど
なかなか腕が立つみたいだし
en: That fight was a bad matchup, sure, but you two can clearly handle yourselves.

jp: あんたたちならきっと
en: For you guys, the special exception is no pipe dream!
Special exception?

jp: リーダーに認められればという
en: You mean being acknowledged by Cypherpunk's leader?

jp: ま、ぶっちゃけて言えば
手柄を上げればいいってわけ♪
en: Well, to put it bluntly, you just have to pull off something big~

jp: 何か含みを感じるが・・・
en: I sense an ulterior motive...

jp: 俺にだって下心はあるさ
en: Sure, I've got my own angle too.

jp: お互い悪い話じゃないだろう？
それに、個人で出来ることには
en: Not a bad deal for either side, right? Besides, there's only so much one guy can do.

jp: 命がいくらあっても足りない
en: Keep repeating days like today and you'll run out of lives fast.
Hmm.. there is something to that.

jp: 個人では、いずれ近いうちに
行き詰まってしまう可能性も
en: On our own, there is a real chance we hit a dead end before long.

jp: いずれ＜サイファーパンク＞に
身を寄せることになるのなら
en: If we are to end up relying on Cypherpunk eventually,

jp: 心を決めておいた方が
en: perhaps it is better to make up our minds sooner.
...Yeah.

jp: 考える時間も欲しいだろう？
en: Well, it's sudden. You'll want time to think, right?

jp: 俺はさっきの酒場に出入り
en: I'm usually around that tavern from before.

jp: そっちに顔を出してくれよ
en: Once you've made up your minds, come find me there.
Okay.
See ya.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
